comment:
No actionable issue identified in the source-reviewed scope at `52f8fa61`.

**Verified (source inspection):** Both tray layouts wire left-click to toggle `expanded`, preserve right-click management, and use the same effective-open condition for the drawer and chevron direction.

| State | Before | This PR |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Hover ends while a management or tray-item menu remains open | Drawer targets closed | Drawer targets open |
| No expanded state or open menu | Drawer targets closed | Drawer targets closed |
| Left-click on chevron | No toggle handler | Toggles `expanded` |

Popup close clears both menu-open flags. Click does not independently pin the drawer open: the existing hover-exit handler still clears `expanded` when no menu is open.
